description: This file implements a FastAPI backend service for a notes application, including endpoints for health checks, note CRUD operations, and API informational endpoints. It uses in-memory storage and Pydantic models.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Pydantic model for the base note fields, including title and content.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a note, inherits from NoteBase.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a note with optional fields.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the full note with an ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health_check()
methods.description: Returns a JSON indicating the service is healthy.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] api_usage()
methods.description: Provides API usage information and links.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes()
methods.description: Returns all notes stored in memory.

methods.name: Note create_note(note: NoteCreate = Body(..., description="Payload to create a new note"))
methods.description: Creates a new note with a generated UUID.

methods.name: Note get_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: Note replace_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), note: NoteCreate = Body(..., description="New data for the note"), )
methods.description: Replaces all fields of an existing note.

methods.name: Note update_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), note: NoteUpdate = Body(..., description="Partial update payload"), )
None delete_note( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Updated content of the note")$/

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content: str = Field("", description="Body\/content of the note")$/

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(note: NoteCreate = Body(..., description="Payload to create a new note")) -> Not/
ctags.signature: (note: NoteCreate = Body(..., description="Payload to create a new note"))

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), )

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), )

ctags.name: id
ctags.pattern: /^    id: str = Field(..., description="Unique identifier (UUID4) for the note")$/

ctags.name: replace_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), note: NoteCreate = Body(..., description="New data for the note"), )

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Updated title of the note")$/

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title: str = Field(..., description="Title of the note")$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), note: NoteUpdate = Body(..., description="Partial update payload"), )
